info.title: HQ API
info.description:
Every API the **HQ** product uses, in the order you meet them: signing up and onboarding in Accounts, the Product Session, then the Company APIs HQ calls with its JWT. Each operation has the story it comes from, when to call it, a request and response example, and every error it can return with its `code`.

This page is generated from the code (`pnpm docs:api`), like the main reference at [/docs](/docs), so it always matches what the API does. The design notes are in the repository: [product-session.md](https://github.com/primeshelfspace/platform/blob/main/docs/product/stories/product-session.md) and [product-company-apis.md](https://github.com/primeshelfspace/platform/blob/main/docs/product/stories/product-company-apis.md).

## The flow

1. **Accounts** (group 1). The person signs up (`POST /auth/register`) or signs in (`POST /auth/login`) and gets an **Accounts session token**. Onboarding, in order:
   - Register Your Company;
   - Add Your Brand;
   - Select Your Products, enabling HQ.
2. **Continue into HQ** (`POST /company/products/HQ/continue`). This returns HQ's address, a **JWT** (12 hours) and a **refresh token** (30 days). The browser goes to `https://<hq>#token=<JWT>&refreshToken=<refresh token>`.
3. **HQ starts.** It reads both tokens from the URL fragment, keeps them in local storage and clears the fragment. Then:
   - `GET /product-session/me` gives the user, `companyId` and role;
   - `GET /companies/{companyId}` gives the Company and the user's Brands.
4. **HQ works.** Every call sends `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>`. The Company Admin manages Brands, users and roles (groups 4–6).
5. **When the JWT expires**, `POST /product-session/refresh` returns a new one. When the refresh token has expired too (`401 SIGN_IN_REQUIRED`), the user signs in again through Accounts.

## Trying it on this page

1. `POST /auth/login` (Try it out) returns `token`. Click **Authorize**, paste it under **accountsSession**, and close.
2. `POST /company/products/{product}/continue` with `product` = `HQ` returns the HQ `token`. Paste it under **productJwt** in **Authorize**.
3. Every HQ call on this page now sends the JWT.

Until HQ has a web address on the server (`HQ_PUBLIC_URL`), Continue into HQ answers `409 PRODUCT_NOT_AVAILABLE`. To try groups 2–6 before then, continue into `INVOICING` instead: the same APIs answer, with Sugrpay's roles in place of HQ's.

## Two tokens

| Token                     | Comes from                                        | Used for                             | Lasts    |
| ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ | -------- |
| **Accounts session**      | `POST /auth/login`, `POST /auth/register`         | Group 1 (onboarding, Continue)       | 12 hours |
| **HQ JWT** (`productJwt`) | Continue into HQ, `POST /product-session/refresh` | Groups 2–6                           | 12 hours |
| **Refresh token**         | Continue into HQ                                  | `POST /product-session/refresh` only | 30 days  |

- The JWT names the user, the Company and the product, so HQ never sends a user ID or a Company ID. Company Profile is the exception: it takes the Company ID and checks it.
- The platform refuses a JWT that is invalid or expired, whose session has ended, or for a product the Company no longer has enabled.
- The refresh token is never accepted as a Bearer token.
- An Accounts session token on an HQ endpoint gets `403 PRODUCT_TOKEN_REQUIRED`.

## Who may do what

- **Company Admin:** the account that signed the Company up. It has company-level access, so all of the Company's Brands are its automatically, and it shows as role `COMPANY_ADMIN`. Only the Company Admin manages Brands and users and reads the user and role lists.
- **Everyone else:** they hold one **HQ role** (`EXECUTIVE`, `MANAGER` or `ASSOCIATE`) and see only the Brands **assigned** to them. Their Sugrpay role, if any, is never returned to HQ.
- **Isolation:** a Company never sees or changes another Company's data. A Brand or user of another Company is refused (`403` or `404`), and nothing about it is returned.

## Errors

- Errors are `{ statusCode, error, message }`. Many also carry a `code`, listed on each operation. Branch on `code`, not on `message`.
- Validation errors are `400 { message: "validation failed", issues: [{ path, message, code }] }`, one issue per field problem. Show them next to their fields.
- Field errors the API finds against its data (`EMAIL_TAKEN`, `PHONE_INVALID`, `ROLE_NOT_AVAILABLE`, `BRAND_NOT_IN_COMPANY`, `DISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN`) carry the same `issues` list, naming the field.

| Status | Meaning                                                                              |
| ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `400`  | The request is invalid (see `issues`).                                               |
| `401`  | No valid token. For the JWT: refresh, then retry once; else sign in again.           |
| `403`  | Signed in, but not allowed: not the Company Admin, wrong token, or not your Company. |
| `404`  | Not found, or not yours.                                                             |
| `409`  | Conflicts with existing data (a name or email taken, a step done or not done yet).   |
| `429`  | Too many requests: wait and retry.                                                   |

## Conventions

- **IDs** are UUIDs. **Dates** are ISO 8601, UTC.
- **Currency** is an ISO 4217 code (`USD`), and a **timezone** is an IANA name (`America/New_York`).
- **Colors** are `#RRGGBB`. A **phone** is `{ country: "US", number }`, returned with its dialling code and E.164 form.
- **Lists** are returned whole. Ask again whenever you need fresh data: every answer reflects the latest roles, Brands and users.

## Coming next

HQ's own APIs will be added to this page as they are built, from their stories:

- Locations (stores and warehouses);
- the product catalog;
- stock;
- purchase orders and receiving;
- transfers;
- sales-channel sync.

tags.name: 1. Accounts: sign up and onboarding
tags.description: Before HQ: the Accounts web app signs the person up, registers the Company, adds its first Brand and enables HQ, then sends the user into HQ with a JWT. These calls use the **Accounts session token** (`accountsSession`), not the HQ JWT. Stories 1–4.

tags.name: 2. Product Session
tags.description: HQ arrives with a 12-hour JWT and a refresh token. Ask who is signed in, and refresh the JWT when it expires. Story 5.

tags.name: 3. Company Profile
tags.description: The Company's details and the Brands the user can access. Story 6.

tags.name: 4. Brand Management
tags.description: The Company Admin adds, edits and archives Brands from HQ. Story 7.

tags.name: 5. User Management
tags.description: The Company Admin lists, adds, edits, deactivates and reactivates the Company's users. Stories 8 and 9.

tags.name: 6. Role List
tags.description: HQ's roles, for choosing one when adding or editing a user. Story 10.

post.summary: Sign Up with a company email and a password (12+ characters)
post.description:
**Story:** Sign Up, Sign In, Forgot Password

Creates the account with a **company email** (not a personal provider such as Gmail) and a password of at least 12 characters. The person becomes the **Company Admin** of a new Company.

Returns an **Accounts session token** (12 hours) and `nextStep: REGISTER_COMPANY`. Use the token as `accountsSession` for the rest of onboarding.

**Authorization:** none

---

Sign Up with a company email and a password (12+ characters). Free email providers are refused; one account per email across every company (409 EMAIL_TAKEN). Creates the company with the person as its Company Admin, signs them in (token, as login) and returns nextStep REGISTER_COMPANY. No product is enabled yet.

**Access:** public
**Served by:** the platform API — `apps/platform/src/modules/auth/interface/auth.controller.ts` (`AuthController.register`)

post.description:
**Story:** Sign Up, Sign In, Forgot Password

Signs in with email and password. Returns an **Accounts session token** (12 hours).

Then call `GET /merchant/onboarding`: when `nextStep` is not `SELECT_PRODUCTS` with onboarding complete, the user finishes onboarding first.

**Lockout:** 5 wrong passwords in a row lock the account for 2 hours, even against the right password. Every failure answers the same, so it never tells whether the email exists.

**Authorization:** none

---

Signs in with email and password. Returns the session token (also set as a cookie) and its expiry. Locks the account after 5 failures in 15 minutes.

**Access:** public
**Served by:** the platform API — `apps/platform/src/modules/auth/interface/auth.controller.ts` (`AuthController.login`)

post.description:
**Story:** Select Your Products & Redirect

Any user of the Company. For `HQ`, returns HQ's web address, the **HQ JWT** (12 hours) and a **refresh token** (30 days).

The Accounts app sends the browser to `url#token=<JWT>&refreshToken=<refresh token>`. HQ reads both from the URL fragment (it never reaches a server log), keeps them in local storage, removes the fragment from the address bar, and sends the JWT as `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>` on every call.

**Until HQ has a web address** (`HQ_PUBLIC_URL` on the server), this answers `409 PRODUCT_NOT_AVAILABLE` for HQ.

**Authorization:** the Accounts session token, `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (**accountsSession**)

---

Continue into a product: returns its URL, a 12-hour JWT (HS256; sub user, mid company, aud product, sid session) with expiresAt, and a refresh token (30 days) with refreshExpiresAt. The product sends the JWT as a Bearer token on every platform call. Only for a product enabled for the company (409 PRODUCT_NOT_ENABLED); 409 PRODUCT_NOT_AVAILABLE when the product has no web address yet (HQ until HQ_PUBLIC_URL is set).

**Access:** ORGANISATION_PROFILE:READ
**Served by:** the platform API — `apps/platform/src/modules/subscriptions/interface/products.controller.ts` (`ProductsController.continueInto`)

get.description:
**Story:** Product Session — User Details & Tokens

Who is signed in, from the JWT alone: no user or Company ID is sent. Call it when HQ opens, then call Company Profile with `companyId`.

- `role` is `COMPANY_ADMIN` for the Company Admin; for anyone else it is their **HQ** role (`EXECUTIVE`, `MANAGER` or `ASSOCIATE`) only, never their Sugrpay role.
- Read fresh on every call: a role changed by the Company Admin shows at once.
- `expiresAt` is when this JWT expires: refresh shortly before it.
- Company details and Brands are not here (Company Profile has them).

**Authorization:** the HQ JWT, `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>` (**productJwt**)

---

Product Session: who is signed in, from the product's JWT alone (no user or Company id). Returns user (id, name, email), companyId, product, role (COMPANY_ADMIN for the Company Admin, otherwise the user's role in the asking product only) and the JWT's expiresAt. Read fresh each call. 401 for an invalid or expired JWT or a product no longer enabled; 403 PRODUCT_TOKEN_REQUIRED for a platform session.

**Access:** ORGANISATION_PROFILE:READ
**Served by:** the platform API — `apps/platform/src/modules/auth/interface/product-session.controller.ts` (`ProductSessionController.me`)

401.description: No JWT, or it is invalid, expired, or its product session ended; or HQ is no longer enabled for the Company. Refresh the JWT (POST /product-session/refresh) and retry once.

401.summary: No JWT, or it is invalid, expired, or its product session ended; or HQ is no longer enabled for the Company. Refresh the JWT (POST /product-session/refresh) and retry once.

value.message: authentication required

403.description:
**`PRODUCT_TOKEN_REQUIRED`**: Called with an Accounts (platform) session token instead of the HQ JWT.

**`NO_PRODUCT_ACCESS`**: The user holds no HQ role (and is not the Company Admin).

PRODUCT_TOKEN_REQUIRED.summary: PRODUCT_TOKEN_REQUIRED: Called with an Accounts (platform) session token instead of the HQ JWT.

value.message: call this with the product's JWT

NO_PRODUCT_ACCESS.summary: NO_PRODUCT_ACCESS: The user holds no HQ role (and is not the Company Admin).

value.message: you have no access to this product

post.description:
**Story:** Product Session — User Details & Tokens

Exchanges the refresh token for a **new 12-hour JWT**, without the user signing in again. No Authorization header: the refresh token is the credential. The refresh token itself does not change.

**Suggested HQ logic:** refresh a minute before `expiresAt`, or when any call answers `401`; retry the call once with the new JWT. If refresh answers `401 SIGN_IN_REQUIRED` (the refresh token has expired after 30 days) or `401 INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN`, clear local storage and send the user to Accounts to sign in.

**Authorization:** none

---

Product Session: exchanges the refresh token for a new 12-hour JWT and its expiresAt, without signing in again. 401 SIGN_IN_REQUIRED once the refresh token has expired (sign in through the platform); 401 INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN for any other refused token (unknown, revoked, product no longer enabled, user suspended).

**Access:** public
**Served by:** the platform API — `apps/platform/src/modules/auth/interface/product-session.controller.ts` (`ProductSessionController.refresh`)

**`SIGN_IN_REQUIRED`**: The refresh token has expired.

get.description:
**Story:** Company Profile — Company Details & Brands

Send the `companyId` from `GET /product-session/me`. Any signed-in user.

- `company`: details; `contactEmail` is the company email used at sign-up.
- `brands`: the Brands this user can access — **all** of them for the Company Admin, otherwise only those **assigned** to the user (possibly none). Archived Brands are included with `archived: true`. `themeColor` is `null` when none was set.
- Use the Brand IDs in further calls. No role and no Locations here. Ask again whenever fresh data is needed.

**Authorization:** the HQ JWT, `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>` (**productJwt**)

---

Company Profile: the Company's details (id, companyName, legalName, taxId, brandStructure, status, contactEmail = the sign-up email) and the Brands this user can access (all for the Company Admin, otherwise only those assigned), each with id, legalName, displayName, currency, timezone, themeColor (null when none set), status and archived. Read-only. 403 NOT_YOUR_COMPANY for any other Company id.

**Access:** ORGANISATION_PROFILE:READ
**Served by:** the platform API — `apps/platform/src/modules/product-company/interface/company-profile.controller.ts` (`CompanyProfileController.get`)

post.description:
**Story:** Brand Management

Company Admin only. Adds an **active** Brand to the signed-in Company.

- Required: Legal Name, Display Name, Currency (ISO code, e.g. `USD`), Timezone (IANA, e.g. `America/Chicago`). Optional: Theme Color (`#RRGGBB`).
- Display Name must be unique within the Company, ignoring case and extra spaces; another Company may use the same name.
- There is no limit on the number of Brands, whatever Brand Structure was chosen.
- Returns the new Brand's ID: use it in further calls.

**Authorization:** the HQ JWT, `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>` (**productJwt**)

---

Brand Management (Company Admin): adds a Brand. Legal Name, Display Name (unique within the Company, ignoring case and spacing; 409 DISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN), Currency and Timezone required; Theme Color optional. Not limited by the Brand Structure. Returns id, displayName and status (ACTIVE).

**Access:** BRANDS:WRITE
**Served by:** the platform API — `apps/platform/src/modules/product-company/interface/product-brands.controller.ts` (`ProductBrandsController.add`)

put.description:

post.description:
**Story:** User Management — Users, Roles & Access

Company Admin only. Adds an **active** user to the signed-in Company. They sign in with this email and password.

- All required: `name`, `email` (unique across the platform), `phone` (`country`: 2-letter code, `number`: valid for that country), `password` (at least 12 characters), `role` (an `id` from `GET /company/roles`) and `brandIds` (at least one Brand of the Company).
- The Company Admin is not assigned Brands: they have all of them.
- Returns the user with their HQ role, Brands and status.

**Authorization:** the HQ JWT, `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>` (**productJwt**)

---

User Management (Company Admin): adds an active user who signs in with the email and password given. Name, email (unique across the platform; 409 EMAIL_TAKEN), phone { country, number } (valid for that country; 400 PHONE_INVALID), password (the platform's rules), role (one of GET /company/roles; 400 ROLE_NOT_AVAILABLE) and at least one Brand of the Company (400 BRAND_NOT_IN_COMPANY), all required.

**Access:** USERS:WRITE
**Served by:** the platform API — `apps/platform/src/modules/product-company/interface/product-users.controller.ts` (`ProductUsersController.add`)

get.description:
Whether the API and what it depends on (database, Redis, storage) are up. `200` when every check is up, `503` otherwise. No sign-in.

**Authorization:** none

---

Overall status, environment, active adapters and each dependency's state.

**Access:** public
**Served by:** every API (platform, Sugrpay and HQ) — `packages/server/src/health/health.controller.ts` (`HealthController.summary`)

503.description: At least one check is down.

productJwt.description: The HQ JWT: `token` from `POST /company/products/HQ/continue` or `POST /product-session/refresh`. Lasts 12 hours.

accountsSession.description: The Accounts session token: `token` from `POST /auth/login` or `POST /auth/register`. Used only for onboarding and Continue.

mustResetPassword.description: True for a user who has never signed in with a password of their own choosing — an INVITED account signing in for the first time with the temporary password whoever created it set. The client's only obligation on seeing this is to send them to set a real one before anything else.

CodedError.description: An error. `code`, when present, says exactly which one: branch on it.

issues.description: For field errors: the field(s) at fault.

contactEmail.description: The company email used at sign-up.

brands.description: The Brands this user can access: all of them for the Company Admin, otherwise only those assigned to the user.

continueWith.description: Open this product straight away: exactly one is enabled. Otherwise the user picks with Continue.

nextStep.description: Where onboarding stands; the web app opens this step's screen.

themeColor.description: Null when none has been set.

canEnable.description: The Company Admin may enable it (it is not enabled yet).

url.description: Where to send the user; the token goes in the URL fragment.

token.description: The 12-hour JWT the product sends with every platform call.

refreshToken.description: Gets a new JWT when it expires (POST /product-session/refresh).

token.description: The JWT, and when it expires (ISO).

phone.description: Null for accounts made before phones were recorded (e.g. at sign-up).

role.description: COMPANY_ADMIN for the Company Admin; otherwise the role in the asking product only, or null when they hold none there.

brands.description: All of the Company's Brands for the Company Admin; otherwise the Brands assigned to the user.

user.description: The details held on the account; for a sign-up account, the sign-in email.

companyId.description: The Company the user is signed in to.

product.description: The product the JWT was issued to.

role.description: COMPANY_ADMIN for the Company Admin; otherwise the role in this product only.

expiresAt.description: When the JWT expires (ISO); refresh it then.
